name: suktum
description: Suktum — réseau social vidéo pour le Sénégal et l'Afrique de l'Ouest. Migration du prototype vers Firebase.

scripts.emulators: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --project suktum-dev
scripts.test:rules: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project suktum-dev "node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/rules/*.test.mjs"
scripts.test:e2e:firebase: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project suktum-dev "SUKTUM_BACKEND=firebase playwright test --workers=1"
